desc:
⌛Experience a Tower Defense game throughout time! After the invention of the Time Machine, anomalous activities have been growing in numbers due to over-usage of the time machine. You have been recruited by the Time Lord in order to deal with these anomalies scattered throughout time. Venture through different time periods in human history, face off against powerful entities corrupted by time, and fight for what's right to complete your task.

🦣 Chrono Warfare is the official successor to Evolution Evade, a Tower Defense game made in 2020! (EVOLUTION EVADE IS NOT CANON TO THE STORY AND WORLD OF CHRONO WARFARE!)

⚠️Chrono Warfare is currently unfinished, and is still under development. We appreciate any feedback you have for this game; it will help us on our journey!

⌚Current playable Eras: Prehistoric Times, Ancient Civilizations, Medieval Times
